rules.explain: SELECT count(*) FROM opera.helper_settle_pricing_subportfoliovalues_view v WHERE v.tenant_id = :tenant

SELECT count(*) FROM opera.helper_settle_p_and_g_view_cache_table h LEFT JOIN opera.helper_actual_settle_p_and_g_view_cache_table a ON a.tenant_id = h.tenant_id AND a.business_unit = h.business_unit AND a.trade_id = h.trade_id LEFT JOIN opera.helper_settle_pricing_and_traders_pricing_view sp ON sp.tenant_id = h.tenant_id AND sp.business_unit = h.business_unit AND sp.security_id = h.security_id LEFT JOIN opera.fx_nc_factor_view fx ON fx.tenant_id = h.tenant_id AND fx.business_unit = h.business_unit AND fx.trade_id = h.source_trade_id LEFT JOIN opera.helper_calculate_future_price_view fp ON fp.tenant_id = h.tenant_id AND fp.business_unit = h.business_unit AND fp.security_id = h.p1_name AND fp.value_date = h.value_date LEFT JOIN opera.security_settlement_value_table ssv ON ssv.tenant_id = h.tenant_id AND ssv.business_unit = h.business_unit AND ssv.security_id = h.security_id AND ssv.value_date = h.value_date WHERE h.tenant_id = :tenant AND h.business_unit IN ('orm', 'osg', 'rmc', 'ORM', 'OSG', 'RMC')

SELECT count(*) FROM opera.helper_settle_p_and_g_view_cache_table h LEFT JOIN opera.helper_calculate_future_price_view fp ON fp.tenant_id = h.tenant_id AND fp.business_unit = h.business_unit AND fp.security_id = h.p1_name AND fp.value_date = h.value_date LEFT JOIN opera.security_settlement_value_table ssv ON ssv.tenant_id = h.tenant_id AND ssv.business_unit = h.business_unit AND ssv.security_id = h.security_id AND ssv.value_date = h.value_date LEFT JOIN opera.helper_calculate_trade_price_yield_view ty ON ty.tenant_id = h.tenant_id AND ty.business_unit = h.business_unit AND ty.trade_id = h.source_trade_id WHERE h.tenant_id = :tenant AND h.business_unit IN ('rba', 'rbc', 'RBA', 'RBC')
